title: Preserve shared contrast scale through localization and fitting
statement: The source derives ||m-lambda r||<=lambda tau and r dot m>=lambda(1-tau^2/2), with the same lambda scaling wrong-site leakage. Maximum coarse score selects the site, and normalizing the two fine columns removes the unknown contrast magnitude before proper fitting. This avoids inventing an inverse-contrast penalty on the systematic locality error.

requires: Known n-qubit output register and q ordinary logical inputs; unknown fixed distinct on-site X/Z logical factors
Exact logical X/Z generators within supplied global operator norm tau<=1/4 of unknown fixed on-site oriented pairs
Positive conditional X/Z CP contrasts for acquisition; separate identity dominance for full-CPTP oracle comparison
Persistent fixed-axis tube and uniform complete calibration/service error budgets
provides: A finite noisy-direction acquisition route retaining the correct robustness scale
assumptions: Conditional means may drift; only the reference axes/tube persist
The crude raw-fit bound does not prove that raw Procrustes intrinsically has that penalty
costs: Fixed ordinary coarse/fine block schedule, all q preparations/n readouts and bad-history fine calls
Rational normalization, proper quaternion fit, one-qubit controls, all record/synthesis/routing/randomness costs
contract.units: Bell loss/global Bell-test failure and averaged half-diamond or permitted strategy distance only where the source supplies that conversion. Block calls, total qubit traffic, bits, controls, routing and memory are separate.
contract.obstruction: Treating a relative positive contrast cone as arbitrary additive bias loses governing structure.

evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: The approximation tube and contrasts are structural promises, not finite-data membership certificates. The bound is uniform in future memory while axes stay in the same persistent tube; arbitrary drift is excluded. It does not reconstruct a full encoding, supply a gauge spectral floor, establish redundant-code recovery or turn operator proximity into a local-stochastic threshold. Optional twirling and implementation discrepancies retain complete service scope. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Acquired completed independent main/statistics review at the exact source version pinned in its receipt. Pending source headers are historical; actual conditional internal acceptance is sufficient. This insertion performs source correspondence and retrieval checks only.
